contentItem.title: 性质与证明：可公度量与中项无理线段与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line commensurable with that which produces with a rational area a medial whole is a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line commensurable with that which produces with a rational area a medial whole is a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole.
直线可公度, 以有理面积 a 中项无理线段整数生产, 直线以有理面积 a 中项无理线段整数生产。（相关点与线段：A）
Let AB be a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole, and CD commensurable with AB; I say that CD is also a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole.
让AB成为一条直线,以有理面积 a 中项无理线段整数,CD 可公度 310 AB整数;我说,CD 也是一条直线,以有理面积 a 中项无理线段整数。

For let BE be the annex to AB; therefore AE, EB are straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on AE, EB medial, but the rectangle contained by them rational. [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
设 BE 是附加在线段 AB 上的线段，于是 AE、EB 是两条平方不可公度的线段；它们的平方和为中项无理量，而以它们为边的矩形面积为有理面积。 [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
Let the same construction be made.

Then we can prove, in manner similar to the foregoing, that CF, FD are in the same ratio as AE, EB, the sum of the squares on AE, EB is commensurable with the sum of the squares on CF, FD, and the rectangle AE, EB with the rectangle CF, FD; so that CF, FD are also straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on CF, FD medial, but the rectangle contained by them rational.
这样,我们可以以与上述相似的方式证明,CF,FD与AE,EB的比相同,AE,EB为正方形,CF,FD为正方形,CF,FD为矩形,AE,矩形,EB,CF,FD,正方形,CF,FD,正方形,FD,中项无理线段,矩形,有理；上述对应量不可公度。
Therefore CD is a straight line which produces with a rational area a medial whole. [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)] Q. E. D.
因此,CD是一条直线,总产值为有理面积 a 中项无理线段 整数。 [[X. 77](/principles/euclid-10-77)]
